title: John S NDE 7810
content: It was night time and it was raining. My mate and I where speeding around the roads of and I did not to have a seat belt on. On top of that, I had a few unsheathed knives on the floorboard by my feet. It's hard to remember the initial point of contact, but when the cars touched, everything became extremely lucid. At one point I remember everything froze as if time had momentarily stopped. I recall seeing the knife hanging there in mid-air. It felt like a lifetime had passed. All I could think of was that if I didn't find a way to stop the knife, it will impale my mate. So I threw myself in front of the knife as hard as I could. Upon contact with the cold steel, the last thing I remember was seeing stars. Darkness washed over me. I felt powerless, like this was the end of everything. A deep vast nothingness surrounded me, yet I did not feel alone. It felt like whatever was with me had a great evil resonating from it. I shouted and screamed, 'No, not like this! I have to go back. He needs me. He needs me to make everything alright.' It became a chant and a plea because I did not want to die. There was so much I wanted to see and so much I missed out on. I closed my eyes slowly. Then I felt myself descending fast . I opened my eyes to find myself limp and my mate frantic. I fell to my knees feeling terrified seeing myself like that. I was enraged that there was nothing I could do to comfort him. I was sick to find I put him at such a risk and glad, that I did whatever I could to save him. Even though it cost me my life, I felt a hand grip my shoulder. I turned to see no one there. A disembodied voice whispered in my ear. 'Why do we live?' A warmness filled the air around me. 'We live to be a part of something much greater than ourselves, to become part of every life and everything,' I replied. I felt the presence move. Faintly, I made out a shadowy figure outlined in the rain. It pointed to my lifeless body. 'Man,' it stated, 'was put on this earth for one reason. To find their own way in their own life. What does this mean to you?' it's voice now booming and filling my ears. 'It means there is no such thing as a useless life, no such thing as a pawn. We are born to fail only so we can learn." Laughter like lightning cracked the air; to an extent I could feel the energy and smell the electronically charged air. 'I have admired your way of thinking for some time now young one, but now it's time to return to the world of the living. Do not fret . I will be watching you, as I have always.' I remember taking the deepest breath I have ever taken in my entire life and letting it out in a scream of pain . The pain felt good, like being alive again. After I calmed my nerves, I cackled in laughter. I told my mate that I have seen the face of God. After the 30 something staples I received and the long walk home, I felt at ease. Aside from the movement problems I experience from time to time, I recovered nicely.

arrival.other_being_detail: A presence in the darkness/nothingness described as having "a great evil resonating from it," later perceived as a "shadowy figure outlined in the rain" with a disembodied voice.

environment.environment_other_detail: Described as "darkness" and "a deep vast nothingness"; later a rainy scene with a "shadowy figure outlined in the rain."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Car crash in rain; experiencer unbelted with unsheathed knives on the floorboard; knife struck him.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Time freeze/slow-motion during impact; interaction with a disembodied voice/shadowy figure; perceived evil presence in the void.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Accident with time-freeze/heightened lucidity, then darkness/void, then rapid descending and OBE at the crash scene, followed by communication and being told to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Time appeared to freeze during the crash with a knife suspended mid-air; presence in the void felt "evil"; later a "shadowy figure outlined in the rain" speaking and laughing "like lightning" with an electrical smell.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Darkness washed over me. I felt powerless, like this was the end of everything." / "A deep vast nothingness surrounded me, yet I did not feel alone." / "Why do we live?" / "Man was put on this earth for one reason. To find their own way in their own life." / "I have admired your way of thinking for some time now young one, but now it's time to return to the world of the living."
